reasoning: Small scattered yellow-orange to reddish pustule-like spots uniformly distributed across the leaf surface on otherwise green leaves. This pattern is characteristic of soybean rust (Phakopsora pachyrhizi), which produces small uredinia appearing as yellowish-tan spots that can show orange-red coloration. The uniform scatter pattern and spot size/color distinguish this from Septoria brown spot (angular brown spots), Frogeye (larger circular lesions), or bacterial diseases (water-soaked angular lesions).
